limits: This is static source review; it does not assert that public collection, root OS cleanup, complete raw replay or any actual ended verifier invocation has succeeded.

Node readline aggregates a complete line before the64MiB check. The accepted trust boundary is producer-schema-bounded SHA/bytes-pinned archives; no adversarial overlong-line memory guarantee is claimed.

For failed partial phases with no report.stage assessment, the tool verifies available raw minute/continuous counters and records an incomplete boundary, not a newly computed whole-partial-phase pass.
